I’ll trace the experiment-metric update and promotion paths, plus the relevant agent guidance, then make the smallest safe fix without running tests or installing anything.
I’m using the repository’s test-authoring guidance because this bug has two focused regression paths that fit existing backend tests.
The two gaps are confirmed: saved-metric creation preserves a supplied metric UUID, and a saved-metrics-only update never normalizes the persisted inline lists. I’m also updating the analytics guidance to make promotion a replacement, not a duplicate attachment.
I’m using the skill-authoring guide as this is a published experiment-agent workflow reference; the change stays in its existing reference rather than adding a new skill.
The fix now assigns a server-owned UUID when a shared metric is created, and on shared-metrics-only updates it regenerates only colliding stored inline UUIDs while preserving their definitions and ordering. I added focused regression coverage for each route; I will not execute it per your instruction.
Implemented the metric-UUID collision fixes.

- New shared metrics now always receive a fresh server-generated UUID, even when created from an inline metric query.
- A saved-metrics-only experiment update now regenerates any colliding stored inline metric UUIDs and keeps ordering correct.
- Updated experiment analytics guidance: promotion omits the UUID and replaces the inline metric rather than attaching both copies.
- Added focused regression tests for both paths.

Changed files include [experiment_saved_metric_service.py](/Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/bench/worktrees/posthog-codex-gpt56-1/products/experiments/backend/experiment_saved_metric_service.py), [experiment_service.py](/Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/bench/worktrees/posthog-codex-gpt56-1/products/experiments/backend/experiment_service.py), and the experiment analytics skill reference.

I did not install dependencies or run the test suite, as requested. `git diff --check` passes.
